text: Have you ever stalked an ex on social media from a burner account?
Did you ever secretly blame a pet or sibling for something you broke or ruined?
Have you ever pretended to be sick to cancel plans, then stayed home doing nothing?
Have you ever eaten food that fell on the floor for longer than 10 seconds?
Did you ever secretly re-gift a present someone gave you back to another friend?
Have you ever lied on your resume or during a job interview?
Have you ever checked someone else's phone when they left the room?
Have you ever pretended to like someone's cooking when it was actually terrible?
Have you ever texted someone while sitting in the same room talking about someone else there?
Did you ever pretend your Wi-Fi died or microphone broke in a meeting to leave early?
Have you ever taken credit for an idea or joke that someone else told first?
Have you ever unfollowed or muted someone in this room on social media?
Have you ever laughed at a joke you didn't understand just to fit in?
Have you ever told someone their baby or pet was cute when you didn't think so?
Did you ever eat someone else's labeled food in the shared fridge?
Have you ever accidentally liked a 3-year-old post while deep-stalking someone?
Do you sing dramatically in the shower when you think nobody is home?
Have you ever practiced an award acceptance speech in front of your bathroom mirror?
Have you ever had a full telepathic conversation with an animal?
Have you ever waved back at someone who was actually waving at the person behind you?
Do you make weird sound effects when you stand up after sitting too long?
Have you ever pushed a door that clearly said PULL in front of a crowd?
Have you ever pretended to look at a watch or phone because you walked the wrong way?
Do you secretly believe you could beat a bear or kangaroo in a fist fight?
Have you ever danced in an elevator and panicked when the doors opened?
Have you ever Googled your own symptoms and convinced yourself you had 48 hours to live?
Do you talk to yourself out loud in foreign accents when alone?
Have you ever sniffed your own socks or shirt to test if they were clean enough to wear?
Have you ever accidentally sent a screenshot of a chat back to the person you screenshotted?
Have you ever pretended to understand a wine or coffee tasting note?
Have you ever worn sunglasses indoors purely because you thought you looked cool?
Do you replay imaginary arguments in your head 3 days later with better comebacks?
If aliens abducted everyone in this room, would you sell us out for free Wi-Fi?
Would you survive more than 48 hours in a zombie apocalypse without takeout?
If you had to fight 100 duck-sized horses or 1 horse-sized duck, do you believe you'd win?
Have you ever suspected your phone's algorithm is reading your unspoken thoughts?
Would you eat a slice of pizza that has been on the moon for 1 million dollars?
Do you believe pigeons are real, or are they secret government surveillance drones?
If a robot clone of you walked into this room, would you team up or immediately fight?
Could you convince a medieval peasant that your smartphone is not witchcraft?
If cats could talk, would yours give you a 5-star review as an owner?
Would you wear socks with sandals on live national television for $5,000?
Do you believe time travelers walk among us and just enjoy our terrible fashion?
If pineapple on pizza were declared illegal, would you smuggle it underground?
